svg.text: EVERY TEST RUN · SAME SIX ORDERS · FIVE ANSWERS PER CELL · GPT-5 MINI
UHC · anemia drug, no cancer dx
Each cell: answers that matched the approved rules, out of five, and the most common wrong answer ("+" when there was another). Times are Central.
"Pages Kanini Context picked" was handed the documents the pack bound to each order, so it is not a fair no-context baseline; it is kept to show that even then one call misses.
